headline_seed: Trump and officials 'likely' targets of press dinner shooting suspect, authorities believe
description_seed: The suspect is expected to be charged with assault of a federal officer and using a firearm during a crime of violence, officials have said.

what: Trump and officials 'likely' targets of press dinner shooting suspect, authorities believe

clean_source_blocks.text: The suspect is expected to be charged with assault of a federal officer and using a firearm during a crime of violence, officials have said.

US President Donald Trump and his officials were the "likely" targets of a suspected gunman who attempted to storm the White House Correspondents' Dinner, acting US Attorney General Todd Blanche has said.

Trump has made the argument in the hours after the annual White House Correspondents’ Association dinner that the nation needs a fortified ballroom on White House grounds so that the president and government officials are not in peril.
The suspect, named by US media as 31-year-old Cole Tomas Allen, was arrested after police said he opened fire near a security checkpoint during the event at a Washington DC hotel on Saturday.
